messages:
Alice (Sales): Hey team — FinServCo POC starts Mon. They want a Dedicated endpoint in us-west-2 with static egress IP(s) for their firewall allowlist and asked about mTLS to the endpoint. Need 30-day reserved POC pricing too. cc @Ben (Solutions) @Carla (Network)

Ben (Solutions): We can provide static egress for Dedicated pools. Options: single EIP per pool or a small set (for HA). Need pool size (qps/concurrency) to price the 30-day reserved POC. Ops fee for mTLS if they want cert-based client auth.

Carla (Network): Networking notes: Dedicated pools use NAT EIPs for outbound. Choices:
- Single EIP (quick test)
- 2+ EIPs for redundancy (recommended)
- Ephemeral NAT rotation is off by default; we can enable but it breaks allowlisting.
For client certs: we can terminate mTLS on our edge for Private; for Dedicated itrequires ops to upload CA/certs and enable client cert verification.

Dave (Eng): Tech constraints: SNI + port 443 only. If they require mTLS, they must provide CA bundle or client certs and an expiry/rotation plan. We'll pin the cert config to the pool. Example placeholder IPs we'll give after provisioning (e.g., 203.0.113.45/32).

Carla (Network): Recommended POC flow:
1) Provision small Dedicated pool (1-2 GPU) in us-west-2.
2) Allocate 2 EIPs and share for allowlist.
3) Customer opens firewall for those EIPs + TCP 443.
4) If mTLS required, customer provides certs and we enable client cert validation.
5) Smoke test with curl, then scale if needed.

Alice (Sales): What exactly do they need to provide for certs and firewall rules? Procurement also needs line-item pricing ASAP.

Eve (Security): Security checklist: TLS 1.2+ enforced. For Dedicated, endpoint TLS keys are managed by us unless they use Private with customer-managed KMS. SOC2 copy available for procurement. mTLS: need CA chain, cert formats, rotation cadence and ops contact. We'll include a short doc for their security team.

Ben (Solutions): I'll prepare the 30-day quote for a minimal Dedicated pool and a one-time mTLS ops setup fee. Also request pool size from the customer.

infra-bot: provisioning requested for Dedicated pool in us-west-2 (small). ETA ~2 hours. Reserving 2 EIPs for this pool.

Carla (Network): For the customer's firewall team, allow: TCP 443 to the following (placeholders until infra allocates real IPs): 203.0.113.45/32 and 203.0.113.46/32. Test command once you have the POC key:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  "https://dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example/v1/chat" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
This checks TLS and routing from their network.

Dave (Eng): Rotation & fallback: if we rotate EIPs mid-POC, we need 48h notice and will provide the new list. If mTLS can't be completed before the start, fallback to token auth + allowlist (lowest friction).

Alice (Sales): I'll request their CA bundle if they want mTLS and push procurement to sign once Ben's quote arrives. Carla/Dave — please post real IPs here when infra finishes. :thumbsup:

Ben (Solutions): Quote will be sent within 3 business hours.

Carla (Network): infra-bot confirms provisioning in progress — will post IPs in-thread once allocated.

Eve (Security): I'll attach SOC2 and an mTLS requirements note for their security reviewer.

Alice (Sales): Update: customer replied — procurement asked for a line item: "30-day Dedicated POC + mTLS ops". I'll attach Ben's quote when ready.
